name: SerenityMind AI SEO
author: idanp1

sections.description:
SerenityMind AI SEO connects your WordPress site to an AI backend to generate optimized SEO titles and meta descriptions for your posts, pages, products, and categories — then lets you review, approve, or reject every suggestion before anything goes live.

Key Features

  • AI-generated SEO fields — Automatically generate SEO titles and meta descriptions for posts, pages, WooCommerce products, and categories.
  • Review & Approve workflow — Every AI suggestion lands in an approval queue. Nothing is written to your site until you explicitly approve it.
  • Google Search Console integration — Connect your GSC property to see live impressions, clicks, CTR, and average position directly in your WordPress dashboard.
  • Priority Generate — Surfaces your highest-opportunity pages (ranked by GSC data) so you generate SEO for what matters most first. Scores are normalized to 0–100 with color indicators (green/yellow/red).
  • Safe writeback — Approved fields are written directly to post meta and term meta, compatible with standard SEO plugins.
  • WooCommerce ready — Full support for products and product categories, including rich category descriptions.
  • Clean admin UI — Minimal, distraction-free interface built into the WordPress admin. No front-end changes until you approve.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Enter your API URL and operator key in the plugin settings.
  3. Optionally connect your Google Search Console property.
  4. Go to Priority Generate or Backlog to trigger AI generation for your pages.
  5. Review suggestions in the Approvals queue.
  6. Approve — and the SEO fields go live instantly.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API (your configured backend URL) to generate SEO suggestions. Data sent includes page URLs, titles, and existing content. No data is sent without your explicit configuration and action. Please review your backend provider’s privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the serenitymind-ai-seo folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to SerenityMind AI SEO → Settings and enter your Backend URL and Operator Key.
  4. Optionally connect your Google Search Console property.
  5. Navigate to Priority Generate or Backlog to start generating SEO suggestions.
sections.faq:
Do I need a license key?

Yes. An active license (operator key) is required to generate AI suggestions. You can obtain one at personalaiseo.com.

Will this interfere with Yoast SEO or RankMath?

SerenityMind AI SEO writes to its own meta keys. If you use another SEO plugin, ensure there is no conflict in how meta tags are output. The plugin outputs standard <title> and <meta name="description"> tags only when no other plugin is handling them.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Products and product categories are fully supported, including bulk generation.

Is anything published automatically?

No. Every AI suggestion must be explicitly approved in the Approvals queue before it is written to your site.

What data is sent to the external API?

Page URLs, page titles, and existing content are sent to your configured backend for AI processing. No personal visitor data is transmitted.
